name: WayriCAD Mechanical Check
description: Local mechanical and interboard collision, clearance, height and hardware review.
description_full: Read-only saved-board mechanical validation with optional second PCB placement, exact FreeCAD/Open CASCADE interboard intersections and cross-sections, model coverage inventory, native conflict viewer and offline HTML/JSON/CSV reports. Requires an installed KiCad 10 Python/CLI and FreeCAD Python. IPC launch opens the saved file; it does not capture unsaved edits. KiCad 11 launch is forward-oriented and unverified; the extraction worker still requires KiCad 10.
